decision_rule: SAME-FLIGHT PERCEPTION TEMPLATE COLUMN READ (NX programme round R6-P1; owner decisions 245-248; instrument E1/E2 at the Perception node; claim ceiling 'nominated'; a MEASUREMENT cell that claims no benefit). One flight, one Perception visit per row, five arms over the SAME QueryState and evidence: p1 (E= presence tag), p2 (E= tag + up to three M= heard mentions), p3 (E= tag with an unsure hedge + mentions), aa (the twin, replicate_of lock) and lock (the locked template, delivering, last); each non-delivering arm is followed by its own first-visit Solver contact (the LOCKED Solver template) over its own note. THE READS, all from this one flight's sealed columns, model-free (scripts/analysis/nx_r6_read.sh): (1) NODE-LOCAL (reader E2b, scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_perception_column_read.py, tag grammar configs/probes/nx/perception/r6/TAG-GRAMMAR-v1.md, p3 read with --tag-set p3=none,some,unsure): per arm, on the rank-1 candidate and on the list majority, the parse classes (ok / absent / invalid), E=none AUC / precision / recall against empty gold, E=some precision / recall against non-empty gold, the unsure rate by gold class, heard-mention containment (share of gold entities whose normalised surface equals an offered M= surface, per slot type) and option precision; the paired intent guards against lock (gold on list, rank-1 share, candidate count, prompt tokens, note parse status); whole-utterance cluster bootstrap CI95, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915. (2) INFORMATION GAIN and the GATE ESTIMATE per candidate arm (scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_r6_upstream_empty.py --verdict-source perception-arm:<arm> --gain-baseline {n1,n1+prior,n1+prior+lock}): the cross-fitted AUC increment of the rank-1 E=none verdict over the baseline for 'gold empty' with a whole-utterance cluster bootstrap CI95 (2,000 draws, seed 20261010), and the delivered-metric estimate of the c3verdict-style gate (verdict E=none AND N1 >= 0.2, plus the fixed N1 grid) on the lock Solver column of the v4g base (10,000 draws, seed 20260915): pp with CI95, false fills removed, non-empty exact lost, intent rows moved. (3) LOCKED-CONSUMER read: each arm's own level-2 Solver column against lock's (the E2 Solver reader inside the node-local pass, and the official pooled SLU-F1 of each column scored once with slurp-slu-official-train and read paired per row). (4) THE TWIN NULL: aa minus lock on every metric, read first. ACCEPTANCE (design sections 2.2 and 4, decision 247): NODE-LOCAL acceptance of an arm = rank-1 E=none recall >= 0.80 and precision >= 0.75 on empty-gold rows, with a rank-1 tag parse rate (ok) >= 0.90 (below that the arm is reported as a FORM FAILURE, not a verdict), and no intent guard moving by more than the twin's own movement plus 0.65 pp; INFORMATION GAIN = the CI95 lower bound of the cross-fitted AUC increment over {N1, intent prior} above zero (additional) -- stability (the same sign and CI-LB > 0 on TRAIN Fold A with the rule fixed on Fold B) is R6-A's term, not this cell's; the delivered-metric estimate is reported through the measured exchange rates (+0.033 pp per false fill removed, -0.070 pp per non-empty exact row lost), with intent rows moved = 0. NOTHING IS LOCKED HERE: this is a selection read on the selection roster. PLATEAU RULE: two evaluated Perception-entity rounds without an arm clearing node-local acceptance close the node; the next lever is then the v2 note contract (decision 248) or the supply-side presence prior, in that order.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-NX-R6-PERCEPTION-FOLD-.conversion_basis: Declared expectation +0.75 pp official pooled SLU-F1 (range +0.75 .. +0.98) = the design's gate estimate (docs/readiness/2026-10-10-slurp-nx-r6-node-local-then-cascade-design-v1.md section 2.2): the c3verdict rule with the verdict source swapped from the Solver-side aggressive arm to the Perception arm's rank-1 E=none, gated by N1 >= 0.2, on the lock Solver column of the v4g base. It is measured only for the Solver-side verdict (docs/results/2026-10-10-slurp-nx-r6-upstream-empty-decision-offline.md section 4: +0.75 [+0.27, +1.24] on iteration 1 and +0.98 [+0.50, +1.48] on iteration 2, 0 intent rows moved, false fill 91 -> 64 and 93 -> 60, 3 non-empty exact rows lost per flight; recall 0.81-0.83 and precision 0.74-0.76 on empty-gold rows) and is conditional on the Perception verdict matching that quality; if it only mirrors N1 the gain is about +0.13 pp (the deterministic gate alone). Exchange arithmetic on the iteration-1 point: 27 false fills x 0.033 = +0.89 and 3 exact rows x -0.070 = -0.21, +0.68 predicted against +0.75 measured. THIS IS A MEASUREMENT CELL under decisions 245/247: it claims NO benefit (claims_benefit false), because +0.75 sits under both the 1.49 pp same-flight floor and the 1.5 pp registration bar of decision 192; it is judged on its node metric and its information gain, and its delivered-metric effect is estimated offline from its own sealed columns before any cascade cell is registered.
